title: 1975 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Rabbit
seo_title: 1975 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Rabbit (11 February – 30 January 1976)
description: 1975 is the Year of the Wood Rabbit (Yin, Yi-mao), from 11 February 1975 to 30 January 1976. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1975.
lead: Born in 1975? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Rabbit, but check the date: the 1975 Wood Rabbit year began on 11 February 1975. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1975: Year of the Wood Rabbit, from 11 February 1975 to 30 January 1976.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1975 was the Year of the Rabbit. It began with Lunar New Year on 11 February 1975 and ended on 30 January 1976, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1975 ends in 5, which makes it a Wood year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1975 is a Yi-mao year. The same Wood Rabbit combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1915 before it and 2035 after it.
Lunar New Year 1975 fell on 11 February 1975, so everyone born in January 1975, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Tiger.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Rabbit guide describes the sign like this: “Gentle, thoughtful, and diplomatic. Rabbits value harmony and are skilled at avoiding conflict.” The usual watch-out: “Can be overly cautious and avoid necessary confrontation.”

The Wood element adds its own flavour. Wood years bring growth, creativity, and a drive to build new things. People of this element tend to be cooperative, generous, and idealistic. Read more in our Wood element guide, or the full Year of the Rabbit page.
Careers often linked with the Rabbit: diplomacy, counseling, design, hospitality.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1975
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Rabbit's best matches are the Goat, Pig and Dog, and its clash sign is the Rooster, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Rabbit, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Rabbit, it shares the Goat's triangle (Rabbit, Goat and Pig), so 2027 is traditionally favourable. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Rabbit years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1951 (Metal Rabbit); 1963 (Water Rabbit); 1987 (Fire Rabbit); 1999 (Earth Rabbit). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1975 is the Year of the Rabbit, a Yin Wood Rabbit year (Yi-mao).
When does the 1975 Year of the Rabbit start and end?
It starts on 11 February 1975 and ends on 30 January 1976.
I was born in January 1975. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Tiger: Lunar New Year 1975 was on 11 February 1975, so all of January 1975 belongs to the Tiger year.
Wood. 1975 ends in 5, which belongs to Wood, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Rabbit compatible with?
Traditionally the Goat, Pig and Dog. The Rabbit's clash sign is the Rooster.
